analysis_md:
令

$$
F=2\sin(x+2y-3z)-x-2y+3z
$$

可得：

$$
F_x=2\cos(x+2y-3z)-1,\qquad F_y=4\cos(x+2y-3z)-2,
$$

$$
F_z=-6\cos(x+2y-3z)+3
$$

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F_x}{F_z}=\frac{2\cos(x+2y-3z)-1}{6\cos(x+2y-3z)-3}=\frac{1}{3},\qquad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F_y}{F_z}=\frac{4\cos(x+2y-3z)-2}{6\cos(x+2y-3z)-3}=\frac{2}{3}
$$

$$
\therefore\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=1
$$
